content: For per-key serial async processing (one game's events must never interleave), async-mutex (CJS+ESM, 10M+ weekly downloads, stable since 2024) provides a lightweight per-key Mutex/Semaphore pattern -- keep a Map<gameId, Mutex> and acquire/release around each event-processing call. p-queue is a heavier alternative (concurrency=1 per-game queue) but is ESM-only, which adds friction in a default NestJS CJS build; also its 9.3.1 release is only weeks old relative to research date. async-mutex is the simpler, lower-risk choice for this phase.
